integrationsHub.explainer: Integrations are the services you connect to your online store so it works with the tools you already use. Shipping companies help you issue waybills and follow shipments, payment gateways let your customers pay by card or wallet into your account, and measurement tools like Meta Pixel and Google Analytics 4 show you which campaigns really bring in sales. On Tallaby you connect most of them from the Apps and integrations page in your dashboard, and payment gateways from your payment settings, with no code and no developer.
integrationsHub.closingTitle: Connect your tools to one store
integrationsHub.closingBody: Start with no monthly subscription, then turn on the integrations you need.

meta-pixel.title: Connect your store to Meta Pixel
meta-pixel.lead: Measure your Facebook and Instagram ads and see which campaigns really bring in sales, without code.
what: Meta Pixel is a Meta tool that records what visitors do in your store after clicking your ad: viewing a product, adding it to the cart or placing an order. Meta uses this data to measure your campaigns and improve who sees your ads.

On Tallaby, you paste your Pixel ID into the Apps and integrations page, and store events are sent automatically once a visitor accepts cookies. You can also connect the Conversions API to send purchases from the server, and choose whether Purchase is sent when the order is placed or when it's delivered.

faq.q: Where do I find my Meta Pixel ID?
faq.a: In Events Manager on your Meta Business account, under Data sources.

faq.q: Do I need the Conversions API?
faq.a: It's not required, but it also sends purchases from the server, so your data stays more accurate when a browser blocks the Pixel. Sending Purchase on delivery needs it.

faq.q: When is the Purchase event sent?
faq.a: You choose in the settings: when the order is placed, or when it's delivered. Sending on delivery needs the Conversions API.

faq.q: Does the Pixel work with a product catalog?
faq.a: Yes, separately. Copy your product feed link from the Apps and integrations page and add it as a scheduled feed in Meta's Commerce Manager.

faq.q: How do I check the Pixel is working?
faq.a: Open Test Events in Events Manager, then browse your store, accept cookies and add a product to the cart, and the events will appear. You can also add a test code in the Conversions API settings.

faq.q: Can I connect more than one Pixel?
faq.a: No. You can connect one Pixel per store.
